target_customer: Outpatient clinics, behavioral health practices and digital health platforms that must verify insurance before care
problem: Manual insurance eligibility and benefits checks are slow and error prone, which delays patient conversion and causes surprise billing.
business_model: Usage-based API for eligibility, benefits and insurance discovery
product_category: Healthcare front-end revenue cycle, insurance verification API

founders.name: Ashish Mandavia
founders.background_notes: Former NHS doctor, EMEA commercial director at Quit Genius (YC W18).

founders.name: Lucas Gordon
education: MSc Computer Science, University of London
founders.background_notes: CTO and CISO at Quit Genius; led SOC 2 and HITRUST work.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time eligibility across many payers needs clearinghouse and payer integrations plus HIPAA compliance, standard but demanding work.

defensibility.rationale: Payer connections and compliance create some friction, but the capability was offered by clearinghouses and many AI startups.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents offered eligibility checks, yet Zocdoc, a customer since 2025, bought Sohar in October 2026 in its first acquisition.

market_need_then: Insurance verification is a daily cost for providers; dated spend figures were not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses soharhealth.com, the name plus a category suffix.

identity.logo: Full colour and white logo versions on the site
identity.visual_style: Clean enterprise healthcare look with SOC 2 and HIPAA badges
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and outcome focused, for example Get More Patients Cleared For Care

brand_strength.rationale: Functional B2B brand with no press about the brand; Sohar also names an unrelated Omani bank and town, so search is noisy.

outcome_analysis: Sohar raised a 3.8 million dollar seed in March 2025 led by Kindred Capital, signed customers such as Talkiatry and Zocdoc, and was bought by Zocdoc in October 2026 at undisclosed terms. Founders with Quit Genius experience in payer integration and compliance helped, and the sale formalized an existing partnership.
notes: Seed cross checked across Coverager, HIT Consultant, Concept Ventures and a press release; some listings add General Catalyst and Character, unconfirmed. Concept Ventures says it backed Sohar at pre-seed in 2022, amount unknown, not recorded. Deal close of 2 October 2026 and announcement 14 October 2026 from trade press. Site still live with a Zocdoc banner. No dated competitor sources near the S23 batch were found (results were 2026 vendor pages), so the list is empty. Founded year 2023 per YC page; another aggregator says 2024.
